findings.claim: Validated exact private local identity configuration opts into original authentication POST only while default readonly business boundaries remain closed.
findings.evidence: material-0.txt load_management_oidc_config enforces schemaVersion='aos.local-management-oidc/v1', issuer='http://127.0.0.1:18448/...', clientId='aos-api'; ReadOnlyManagementApp.__call__ sets login=True only for POST /v1/auth/token when allow_password_login=True; material-4.txt outcome=LOCAL_OIDC_READONLY_ENTRY_CODE_GREEN with optInLoginRoute=POST /v1/auth/token and businessMutationsAllowed=false

findings.claim: Web password credentials and refresh tokens are not persisted or queued; access token is published only after original canonical me succeeds.
findings.evidence: material-2.txt loginPassword calls clearAccessToken before fetch; after /v1/me success calls applyMeToTenant then setAccessToken; test in material-3.txt asserts localStorage access_token is null and sessionStorage refresh_token is null; material-5.txt reports passwordOrTokenStorage=false and canonicalMeRequired=true

findings.claim: Server login policy prevents unauthenticated external-only users mounting business catalog consumers and preserves explicitly enabled legacy development UI.
findings.evidence: material-1.txt LocalLoginGate renders children only when policy is legacy or (password and authenticated); material-3.txt tests show allowDevToken=true preserves children, allowDevToken=false requires login form, unreadable config shows '登录服务暂不可用' and no children; formal-entry-boundary-excerpt.txt shows _require_external_oidc rejects localhost/127.0.0.1; scope-clarification.txt confirms this review does not claim enterprise HTTPS or external OIDC

findings.claim: Reported tests and enrollment are bounded code and metadata evidence; live login and eight workbench acceptance remain unproven.
findings.evidence: material-4.txt liveApiIntegrated=false, eightWorkshopsAccepted=false; material-5.txt liveApiOrWebReloaded=false, eightPagesAccepted=false; material-6.txt businessRuntimeOpened=false, liveLoginAccepted=false; material-7.txt and actual-envelope-correction.txt confirm 13/13 targeted tests GREEN but state 'Browser login/legacy profile hydration and eight runtime pages remain pending'
